title: Hamiltonian dynamics for sampling on discrete spaces
summary: We develop a general class of non-reversible Hamiltonian Monte Carlo dynamics on discrete state spaces. The method augments the discrete state with a continuous momentum variable and does not require a continuous embedding of the discrete state space. We establish conditions for invariance of the target distribution and study the resulting processes in terms of ergodicity, exponential contractivity, asymptotic variance and relaxation time.
